method: Second review from local bytes, independent of classifier scores and registry labels. No specimen had host OS, filesystem, network or native-execution access. Lua evaluation used a restricted Lua 5.5 environment, mocked FFI/Win32/bit modules, disabled Python bridges, and a 10-million-instruction budget. Native pointer execution was stopped.

samples.identification: AutoIt-marked opaque carrier with nested byte-shifted executable configuration; not a valid PE executable
samples.confidence: lower than the market-data package; payload behavior unresolved
samples.reason: The balance favors a concealed payload carrier: the 498759-byte object is named as a Windows program but has no PE header, has two opaque regions, and conceals executable/System/SVCHOST configuration using nested delimiters and an additive byte transform. These deliberate packaging choices, rather than EA06 magic or entropy by themselves, tip the judgment. No specific RAT family or executed behavior is established.
reverse_engineering: file and cleave identify opaque data, not PE. Rizin has no executable image to trace. binwalk found no embedded recognized format.

AU3!EA06 appears at offsets 71113 and 498751. A clear \@/ delimiter at 71121 introduces a 90-byte configuration. Subtracting 120 modulo 256 from each configuration byte yields: 4\@/T\@/System\@/svchost.exe.exe\@/4\@/4\@/System\@/0\@/SVCHOST.EXE\@/4\@/\@/1\@/4\@/4\@/1.
The inner delimiter is D4 B8 A7; the encoded .exe suffix is A6 DD F0 DD. This independently verifies the encoding, including field boundaries, rather than guessing from extracted strings.
Clear \@/nothing\@/ framing follows the configuration. The first opaque region is 71113 bytes before the first EA06 marker; the final region extends from 71227 through the trailing marker.

autoit-ripper and binary-refinery fail to recover a standard script. Neither standard EA06 container magic nor encrypted FILE records occur. Both EA05 and EA06 record/content-key probes, bytewise XOR/additive transforms, and bounded RC4-key candidates failed to recover valid structures. Those failures establish a recovery limit, not benign intent.

The flags have no proven operational meaning without a matching decoder. In particular, System and SVCHOST fields do not establish installation, persistence, process hollowing, privilege escalation, network communication or success.

samples.coverage_gap: One supported suspicious trait for nested arithmetic concealment, zero justified hostile traits. A second suspicious or hostile behavior cannot be inferred from the opaque bodies; do not duplicate encoding or infer process actions to meet a count.
samples.classifier_disagreement: After removal of unsupported hostile format claims, the calibrated ML level is -1 (benign) despite raw probability 0.7137588. Analyst judgment remains likely malicious on the limited packaging/configuration evidence.

samples.identification: MarketData repository lure bundling an obfuscated Windows Lua loader and LuaJIT interpreter
samples.reason: README promotes an unrelated Windows launcher/archive under a market-data project. The launched script implements broad Defender exclusions, concealed execution and durable scheduled payload activation. These operations have no market-data processing purpose.
reverse_engineering: Reviewed Cargo.toml, main.rs, lib.rs, README and all nested archive members. Rust code merely reads text, reports a counter/timestamp and writes JSON. No install/import-time execution hook was found; the manual launcher is the delivery path.
Nested Market-Data-3.0-alpha.5.zip contains Launcher.cmd (start reinit.exe icon.txt), reinit.exe (651776 bytes), and icon.txt (296594 bytes of Lua).

Rizin: native main 0x404750 forwards arguments to 0x405ec5. That function initializes a Lua state (0x409ec0), invokes the interpreter callback at 0x405f2c through 0x407559, processes status and closes the state at 0x406bc2. LuaJIT banner, bytecode options and exported luajit.exe module corroborate the interpreter identity. Generic CRT/Win32 imports are not independent malware capabilities.

Recovered the partial numeric/string fold with cleave facts --format json (305913 characters). Reviewed actual assignments, branches, API wrappers and command concatenations. Decimal escapes, indexed string reassembly, large-number keyed string decoding and numerical VM dispatch conceal the program.

Restricted original-source evaluation requests ffi and bit, registers Windows structures, loads lua51.dll, requests GetConsoleWindow and ShowWindow(...,0), and requests VirtualAlloc(nil,7,12288,64). The recorded seven bytes are 64 a1 30 00 00 00 c3, the x86 PEB accessor. Evaluation stops at cast uint (*)(void), before any native execution. These are mocked requests, not successful Windows calls.

Folded code casts PEB and IMAGE_EXPORT_DIRECTORY pointers and constructs an API table including WinExec, CreateThread, WinInet, registry and CryptoAPI functions. Subsequent indirect calls use this table. No cross-process injection is inferred from local CreateThread.

The loader.bypass_defender==1 branch selects VM state 16312683. The branch concatenates powershell Start-Process, randomized PowerShell comments, -Verb runAs, a hidden window, and Add-MpPreference -ExclusionPath $env:SystemDrive -ExclusionExtension .exe, .dll -Force; it passes the constructed command to the WinExec wrapper. This requests consent-based elevation; it does not implement a proven UAC bypass.

Scheduled-task source formats schtasks /create /sc daily /st %02d:%02d /f, selects random hour 10..14 and minute 0..59, appends /tn and /tr executable arguments, and invokes the WinExec wrapper. Separate branches build Register-ScheduledTask and CurrentVersion\Run/StartupApproved registry writes. Configuration and permissions govern which branches succeed.

The script initializes http://213.176.73.160, constructs an eth_call for 0x1823A9a0Ec8e0C25dD957D0841e3D41a4474bAdc with selector 0x3bc5de30 and Polygon RPC alternatives, and builds /task/ requests. Task dispatch contains executable, rundll32, cmd and hidden PowerShell file-launch paths. No endpoint or later payload was fetched.

GDI capture, WinInet and API-resolution findings are accurate references/capabilities. They do not establish observed exfiltration, completed screenshots or remote-server availability. Every pre-existing finding, including runtime dual-use observations, remains intact.

changes.reason: EA06 marker, size and entropy do not establish hostile concealment; preserve every predicate as a notable file property, with no attack mapping.
Marker plus entropy provides no payload staging, decryption, activation or C2 evidence. Identical required observations retained as notable metadata.

The neighboring rule similarly requires only marker, suffix and size, so it is an artifact observation. Predicates/type gate retained. Opaque .a3x currently routes as unknown, making this legacy data-type combination inactive on the generated .a3x control.
Names now describe signature matches rather than claiming a decoded/validated encrypted body. Matchers, scope and criticality unchanged; references updated.

A bounded byte signature binds outer clear delimiter, shifted inner delimiter and shifted executable suffix. It does not require chosen filenames, process names, exact sizes or hashes. One suspicious concealment observation; no execution/persistence claim.
Adds the missing notable format mismatch using the engine data_as_binary metric; does not claim deception by itself.

consumer_audit.exact_consumers: No production consumer references the three relocated composites by exact ID. Only their definitions referenced the renamed signature group.
consumer_audit.scope_conclusion: All six ancestor consumers require PE/DLL, Python, JavaScript or TypeScript in file scope, disjoint from the relocated data-only rules. No consumer should inherit the neutral metadata as an attack signal. The new data-only concealment rule is likewise disjoint from the anti-static JavaScript consumers.

positive_and_near_miss_review: Generated a valid EA06 container, decrypted/decompiled it independently with autoit-ripper, and verified it contains only an inert variable and ConsoleWrite. Both old hostile rules fired on its .bin representation. The issue is not merely a synthetic lexical near miss: the required compiler-format properties admit legitimate compiled code.

Inspected relevant existing AutoIt source controls and ran all four autoit-document-worm fixtures (operations, renamed, backup, installer); hostile document-masquerade and removable-worm coverage is retained.

Searched the named current samples root for EA06-bearing files; this batch server carrier is the only available raw hit. No independent encrypted AutoIt malicious positive is available in this root. Existing fixture/review records were inspected; they establish source behaviors and standard compiler encoding, not a justification for the retired format-only hostile claims.
Custom encoding controls vary executable names, remove encoded executable suffix, remove outer framing and remove encoding. All eight controls are run by check.py.
material_losses: Two hostile findings disappear on SERVER_Gate.exe; all underlying marker/size/entropy observations are preserved as notable metadata. No market-data finding or archive member is lost. No supported attack behavior was removed.
